— 200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully retrieved the CFT template for the
specified AWS Frictionless Assessment connector and AWS account.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid input parameters, if your request was improperly formatted,
or if an error occurred while processing the request.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to download CFT templates.
— 404
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find not find the specified connector or AWS
account.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
